meta_title: Jack Hall Painting & Decorating | Painter Birmingham
meta_description: Jack Hall Painting & Decorating in Birmingham. Interior and exterior painting, wallpapering, and full decoration services. Local, reliable, competitive quotes.
hero_subhead: Professional painting and decorating that transforms your home. Free estimates, no obligation, competitive rates.
services_heading: Complete Painting & Decorating Services in Birmingham
services_subhead: From interior makeovers to exterior repaints, we handle every job with precision and care.

services.title: Interior Painting
services.desc: Walls, ceilings, woodwork, and feature walls in any colour or finish. We prepare surfaces properly to guarantee a smooth, lasting result.

services.title: Exterior Painting
services.desc: Weather-resistant exterior repaints for fascias, soffits, doors, and brickwork. We use quality paints built to withstand Birmingham's climate.

services.title: Wallpapering
services.desc: Expert wallpaper hanging, pattern matching, and removal. We work with all wallpaper types, from contemporary to vintage designs.

services.title: Furniture & Upcycling
services.desc: Transform old furniture with professional spraying and painting. Perfect for kitchen units, wardrobes, and decorative pieces.

services.title: Commercial Painting
services.desc: Office redecorating, shop interiors, and business premises. Quick turnarounds scheduled to minimise disruption to your operation.

services.title: Surface Preparation
services.desc: Proper prep work including sanding, filling, and undercoating — the foundation of a professional finish that lasts.

about_pullquote: I started this business because I wanted to do the job right the first time, every time.
about_para_1: Jack Hall Painting & Decorating has served Birmingham homeowners and businesses for over 15 years. What began as a one-man operation has grown steadily through word-of-mouth recommendations and a reputation for turning up on time, delivering quality, and cleaning up after ourselves.
about_para_2: We don't cut corners or rush jobs. Every project starts with a thorough site visit and a transparent quote. Our customers come back because they know exactly what they're getting — professional work, honest pricing, and a decorator who treats their home with respect.

reviews.text: Jack painted our lounge and hallway last month. He arrived on time, protected all our furniture, and did a brilliant job. The finish is perfect — no drips, no mess. Already recommended him to two neighbours.
reviews.author: Claire M.

reviews.text: Needed our kitchen units sprayed and we weren't sure who to trust. Jack gave us a fair quote and the transformation was incredible. They look brand new. Really pleased with the work and the price was honest.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Had our entire exterior redecorated — fascias, doors, shutters — the lot. Jack was professional throughout, quality paint, and finished on schedule. Will definitely have him back for the interior next year.
reviews.author: Sarah L.
